{{Quote|The Senate has put a bounty on your horned little head.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>}}
[[File:ShaakTiCloseup-SWBC60.png|thumb|250px|[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti's]] montrals]]
'''Montral''' was a word used by the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] to refer to the hollow horns atop their heads. The Togruta possessed a form of passive echolocation by means of their hollow montrals which allowed them to sense the proximity and movement of physical objects around them.<ref name="ST">{{DB|character|shaakti|Ti, Shaak}}</ref>
